title: 地球環境学
subtitle: Environmental Science of Earth
keywords: Biogeochemical cycle 2.Chemical composiiton of the earth's crust 3.Basic chemical equilibria 4.Environmental issues
educationalGoal: The earth can be divided into the atmosphere, the lithosphere, and the hydrosphere, but elements such as carbon, nitrogen, and phosphorus circulate among all of these spheres. This course will cover the behavior of substances in the global environment and the chemical reactions related to the behavior of the substances. The goal of this course is to raise awareness of the factors affecting the global environment.
advice: 1. Chemical composition of the earth's crust. 2. The evolution of the earth and changes in the atmosphere. 3. Basics of analytical chemistry. 4. Basics of aquatic environment. 5. Chemical equilibria in environmental water. 6. Environmental problems.
books: (Textbook) An Introduction to Environmental Chemistry, Julian E. Andrews, et al., Wiley-Blackwell, ISBN: 9780632059058
requiredKnowledge: A knowledge of high school level chemistry and biology is required to understand the lectures.

activityGoals.body: Understand the origins of the earth and changes in the global environment.
Understand atmospheric changes of the earth from the beginning to the present.
Describe the greenhouse effect caused by carbon dioxide..
Understand major chemical equilibria in environmental water.
Understand the mecanisms of seasonal variations in the water quality of lakes.

achievementLevels.ideal: Can describe the following: - Atmospheric changes of the earth over time - Mechanism of the variation of water quality in lake water - Environmental problems with a concrete example. Students also must be able to give a presentation on a global environmental problem based on journal articles.
achievementLevels.standard: Can describe the following with reference to textbooks, reference books, and dictionaries: - Atmospheric changes of the earth over time - Chemical composition of earth's crust - Biogeochemical cycle of substances - Mechanism of variation of water quality in lake water - Environmental problems Can also understand an article on a global environmental problem.
